classes.name: RigidBody
classes.comment: full rigid body state, pooled 64x at Simulation+0x1c with stride 0x80; no vptr; identical offsets on PS2 and Xbox (PS2 vectors are 16-byte slots whose w slots hold scalars; Xbox keeps the same slots)

fields.name: orientation
fields.evidence: quaternion: SetOrientation(COORD4&) ad330 writes +0x0..+0xc; UpdatePositionAndOrientation b0ec0 R/W; ctor calls VU0_m4toquat. PS2 +0x0/+0x8 w8 in SetOrientation 1f85c0. Name invented

fields.name: position
fields.evidence: addr-taken -> VU0_v4sub in ResetObject/ctor/CollideWith*; PS2 +0x10 same set incl. UpdateZonalInfo. Name invented

fields.name: bodyTensorX
fields.evidence: w slot of the position vector; PS2 GetBodyTensorMatrix4 1f7a80 reads exactly +0x1c/+0x2c/+0x3c; Xbox written in ctor/ResetObject, read in SetOrientation and UpdatePositionAndOrientation (world tensor rebuild). Tensor or inverse unknown; name invented

fields.name: velocity
fields.evidence: PS2 GetLocalVelocity 1f82e8 transforms +0x20 by the info matrix; Xbox GetLocalxxx ad220 does the same with +0x20; zeroed by ForceToSleep/ControlSleep

fields.name: bodyTensorY
fields.evidence: see bodyTensorX; PS2 GetBodyTensorMatrix4 reads +0x2c

fields.name: angularVelocity
fields.evidence: zeroed by ForceToSleep/ControlSleep, used by GenerateImpulse/ResolveLeverForces on both builds; by elimination (+0x20 velocity, +0x40 momentum, +0x50 angular momentum). Xbox GetLocalyyy ad270 probably reads it (not checked)

fields.name: bodyTensorZ
fields.evidence: see bodyTensorX; PS2 GetBodyTensorMatrix4 reads +0x3c

fields.name: momentum
fields.evidence: PS2 GetLocalMomentum 1f81b8 transforms +0x40; ApplyHeavyFriction ad170 damps +0x40 and +0x50

fields.name: mass
fields.evidence: w slot; read by ResolveMassScaledForce/Force4/Torque4 (PS2) and ResolveMassScaledTorque4 ad470, InitLevers, GenerateImpulse. Could be inverse mass; name invented

fields.name: angularMomentum
fields.evidence: SetAngularMomentum ad310 writes +0x50 (via 116240 with the info matrix); ModifyAngularMomentum, ApplyAngularDamping; Xbox GetLocalzzz ad1d0 transforms +0x50 (so it is GetLocalAngularMomentum)

fields.name: info
fields.evidence: pointer to this body's 0x500-byte entry at Simulation+0x24 (ctor calls Simulation::GetRigidBodyInfo); first member is the orientation MATRIX4 (PS2 lq 0x0..0x30 then transpose; Xbox -> VU0_MATRIX4_vect3mult); 20+ readers on both builds. Name invented

fields.name: force
fields.evidence: force accumulator: ResolveForce ad3f0 adds the argument to +0x60 (115ab0); ctor/ApplyInitialForcesAndTorques reset it; PS2 +0x60 w8 +0x68 w4. Name invented

fields.name: flags6c
fields.evidence: byte R/W in ApplyAngularDamping/ApplyInitialForcesAndTorques/ControlSleep/ResetObject/ctor on both builds; meaning unknown, name invented

fields.name: flags6d
fields.evidence: byte R/W in 14 methods (damage, collisions, sleep) on both builds; meaning unknown, name invented

fields.name: sleepState
fields.evidence: ResolveForce: if ==3 ignore the force, else set 2; written by ForceToSleep/ResetObject; PS2 byte +0x6e in the same methods. 3 looks like asleep/frozen, 2 awake. Name invented

fields.name: ownerIndex
fields.evidence: GetOwner ad100: MOVSX [ECX+0x6f] then loads [idx*4+0x2342a0] (owner table); PS2 GetOwner lb +0x6f. Name invented

fields.name: torque
fields.evidence: torque accumulator: ResolveTorque/ResolveMassScaledTorque4 -> VU0_v4scaleadd on +0x70; reset in ctor/ApplyInitialForcesAndTorques; PS2 +0x70 w8 +0x78 w4. Name invented

fields.name: stateFlags
fields.evidence: ResolveForce ad3f0 clears bit 1 (AND ~2) as a dword; byte accesses elsewhere; the gatherer also tags it float; PS2 lw/sw +0x7c. Name invented

classes.name: SimpleRigidBody
classes.comment: point-mass body pooled at Simulation+0x20, stride 0x40; no vptr; same offsets on both builds. Ctor args (Xbox b1e10, as called from the PHelicopter ctor): (int ownerIdx, int type, COORD3& pos, COORD3& vel, COORD3& accel, MATRIX4* orient, float radius, float f8)

fields.name: orientation
fields.evidence: SetOrientation b1f10 writes +0x0..+0xc; ctor converts its MATRIX4* arg with VU0_m4toquat(this,..); PS2 +0x0/+0x8 w8. Name invented

fields.name: position
fields.evidence: ctor copies arg3 COORD3 to +0x10; UpdatePosition writes +0x10..+0x18; CheckCollisions LEA; PS2 same. Name invented

fields.name: bodyType
fields.evidence: ctor stores arg2 byte (PHelicopter passes 8); PS2 +0x1c w[1,4] in ctor/CheckCollisions. Name invented

fields.name: ownerIndex

fields.name: flags
fields.evidence: ctor WORD 0; PHelicopter ctor ORs 0x108; NeedsCollisionCheck reads the low byte, SetCanHitTrigger RMWs the high byte (+0x1f); PS2 halfword +0x1e in all of these. Name invented

fields.name: velocity
fields.evidence: ctor copies arg4; GetScalarVelocity b1f30 = VU0_v3length(this+0x20); Accelerate/UpdatePosition write it; PS2 same. Name invented

fields.name: radius

fields.name: acceleration

fields.name: unknown3c
fields.evidence: ctor stores arg8 (PHelicopter passes 500.0f); PS2 swc1 +0x3c in ctor only. Name invented

classes.name: SimRandom
classes.comment: LCG-style random generator, Simulation's first member; same layout on both builds

fields.name: state
fields.evidence: Reset 5ccb0 sets 0xf874af01 then iterates state=(seed*state)&0xffff seed%50 times; read by SimRandom_Generate. Name invented

fields.name: lastProduct
fields.evidence: Reset stores 0 or the last unmasked seed*state product; Generate R/W. Name invented

fields.name: seed
fields.evidence: ctor 5cc80 and PS2 SetSeed(unsigned int) 17dba8 write +0x8; Reset reads it. Name invented

fields.name: counter
fields.evidence: Reset stores 0 or seed%50 (iteration count); Generate RMW. Name invented

classes.name: PVehicle
classes.comment: abstract vehicle base with an 83-slot vtable; size is a minimum (no deleting destructor or allocation size seen); the subclass (PBondCar) adds the rest. Own fields at the same offsets on both builds (vptr lives in PhysicsObject)

fields.name: missionEditorOnMask
fields.evidence: ctor 6f900 zeroes it; MissionEditorSwitch(bool on,int bit) 71000: on -> |= 1<<bit; off -> &= 0 (compiled as AND with 0<<bit). PS2 +0x6c same methods. Name invented

fields.name: missionEditorOffMask
fields.evidence: mirror of +0x6c: on -> cleared (AND 0), off -> |= 1<<bit; ctor zeroes. PS2 +0x70. Name invented

classes.name: PHelicopter
classes.comment: helicopter physics object; 0x140 on Xbox (FastFree size in 6e300, allocated 320), PS2 0x144: identical offsets up to +0x134, then two PS2 4-byte bools at +0x138/+0x13c pack into bytes +0x138/+0x139 on Xbox and the trailing float moves from PS2 +0x140 to Xbox +0x13c. Owns a SimpleRigidBody in the Simulation pool (slot = PhysicsObject rigidBodySlot +0x4a)

fields.name: heliClass
fields.evidence: ctor stores 1; Simulate R/W; PS2 +0x6c same. Sheet has GetHeliClass(void); mapping unconfirmed, name from sheet

fields.name: roll

fields.name: unknown74

fields.name: actionQueue
fields.evidence: ctor 0; GetControllerInput calls ActionQueue::IsEmpty/GetAction/PopAction on it; ~PHelicopter 6e290 calls ~ActionQueue then FastFree(p,0x974). PS2 +0xa4 same. Name invented

fields.name: unknownA8
fields.evidence: byte, ctor 0, Simulate R/W; PS2 byte at +0xa8 too (padding keeps +0xac aligned). Name invented

fields.name: damageZones
fields.evidence: ctor zeroes 16 x 8-byte entries from +0xac (loop ECX=0x10, stride 8) up to +0x12c; GetDamageZones(uint& n) 6dd10 sets n=16 and returns this+0xac; PS2 ApplyDamage takes +0xac/+0xb0. Name invented

fields.evidence: ctor 0; Simulate R/W; PS2 +0x12c also ApplyDamage. Name invented (AIHelicopter pointer from the sheet is a candidate)

fields.name: unknown130
fields.evidence: ctor -1.0f; PS2 +0x130 float in ApplyDamage (damage timer?). Name invented

fields.name: unknown134
fields.evidence: ctor 0 (twice); Simulate R/W; PS2 +0x134 ApplyDamage/Simulate. Name invented (AIHelicopter pointer is a candidate)

fields.evidence: ctor 1; PS2 4-byte bool at +0x138 (ApplyDamage R/W). Sheet Get/SetScoreable(bool); mapping unconfirmed

fields.name: destructDistance
fields.evidence: ctor 2.0f then an AttributeSet float (582c0, FSTP); PS2 float at +0x140. Sheet GetDestructDistance; mapping inferred

notes: RigidBody and SimpleRigidBody have no vptr and identical offsets on both builds: PS2 uses 16-byte vector slots and puts scalars (tensor diagonal, mass, info pointer, flag bytes) in the w slots; Xbox keeps the same slots.

Xbox RigidBody GetLocalxxx (0xad220) reads +0x20 = PS2 GetLocalVelocity; GetLocalzzz (0xad1d0) reads +0x50 = GetLocalAngularMomentum. GetLocalyyy (0xad270, not checked) is GetLocalMomentum (+0x40) or GetLocalAngularVelocity (+0x30). They return their hidden result pointer (EAX = arg), so the return is given as COORD3 *; PS2 returns COORD3 by value.

RigidBody/SimpleRigidBody GetOwner return entries of global tables 0x2342a0 / 0x2343a0 (0x100 apart = 64 RigidBody owners then SimpleRigidBody owners), indexed by a signed byte; PhysicsObject * inferred from InitLevers(PhysicsObject *, ...).
RigidBody +0x7c is tagged float by the gatherer but ResolveForce treats it as an integer bitmask (AND ~2); typed uint.
PVehicle::MissionEditorSwitch compiles 'mask &= 0<<bit' (XOR EDX,EDX; SHL; AND), i.e. it clears the whole other mask: probably a source bug (missing ~).
PVehicle size 0x74 is a lower bound only: no FastFree/allocation size under its tag, and subclass code is not scanned.
PHelicopter: Xbox 0x140, PS2 0x144: bools at PS2 +0x138/+0x13c pack to Xbox +0x138/+0x139; destructDistance moves PS2 +0x140 -> Xbox +0x13c. All earlier fields at the same offsets.

PHelicopter ctor 6d8f0 calls 0x6f190 (a PhysicsObject constructor variant, descriptor 0x18e54c, arg 10) rather than 0x6f100 used by PVehicle; it gets the SimpleRigidBody via 0xb2730 on Simulation 0x233ff0 (likely Simulation::GetSimpleRigidBody(slot)) and calls SimpleRigidBody::SimpleRigidBody(slot, 8, &destPos, &vel, zero, &mtx, 3.0f, 500.0f).

PHelicopter control floats +0x94..+0xa0, roll/heliClass, scoreable/proximityDestructEnabled and the +0x12c/+0x134 fields are named from the sheet's accessor list by guesswork (low); the inline accessors are not separate functions on Xbox.
SimRandom::Reset (0x5ccb0) is typed uint in Ghidra but EAX is only a leftover product; PS2 Reset(void): given as void.
Placeholders: RigidBodyInfo (0x500, Simulation+0x24 entry, starts with a MATRIX4), ActionQueue (0x974 from the FastFree in ~PHelicopter), DamageZone (8 bytes, 16 per helicopter).
